verdict.rationale: MailerSend documents an endpoint that returns an account's API rate limits and resource limits, so a platform engineer can discover their limits programmatically. The pack gives no actual numbers or throttling semantics. missing for 10: documented requests-per-second figures, burst behavior, rate-limit response headers, 429/throttling error documentation, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can find the documented throughput and rate limits — requests per second, burst behavior, and the headers or errors that signal throttling

citations.quote: Get your account's plan, email usage, API rate limits and resource limits in one request.
